sources.snippet: Text Generation model with 3B parameters, built with Transformers. Download, explore files and run it on Hugging Face.

sources.title: SmolLM3 3B - VRAM Requirements, Specs & Benchmarks
sources.snippet: The model is part of a broader initiative to create lightweight yet impactful AI solutions, making sophisticated language understanding and generation more accessible. Architecturally, SmolLM3-3B is a decoder-only Transformer model, building upon the foundational designs of models like Llama while incorporating specialized optimizations.
